item.title: ⚡ [Meeting] Telluride Board of Education Special Meeting — 2026-11-20
item.description:
Telluride School District • 2026-11-20
A special meeting with a lot packed into one Friday morning. The board takes up a first reading of Policy JJJ — a revised extracurricular eligibility policy that incorporates Colorado's statutory definitions of male and female for athletic team participation, along with updated rules for homeschooled, charter, and nonpublic-school students seeking to participate in district activities. Then the meeting moves into executive session on two fronts: selecting a superintendent search consultant (with reference-check materials protected under CORA's mandatory nondisclosure provisions), and a personnel matter involving Superintendent John Pandolfo. Coming out of executive session, the board votes on approving the search consultant and any investigative action tied to the Pandolfo matter. The board also conducts a self-assessment under GP-4-E.
⚡ Why it matters: Board takes first reading of gender-eligibility athletic policy with public implications.

item.title: [Fri, Nov 20] Ladies Night In!
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Program Room 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM · Join us at the library for an evening of pampering, snacks, and great company. We'll be screening a surprise classic chick flick while enjoying fresh popcorn, artisan chocolate, hot tea, eye patches, and unique nail polishes by Holo Taco. You'll also have the chance to win prizes from local businesses including Studio G, Aveda Telluride Spa, and Two Skirts. Cozy attire and blankets are encouraged. This event is for adults only. Advance registration is encouraged so we know how many self-care supplies to provide :) Gather your girlfriends or come solo and meet someone new at our library Ladies Night In!

item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Wilkinson Public Library, Telluride Move, breathe, and energize in this dynamic bilingual class, led by Lauren Norton, designed to uplift your body and mind! Blending the strength and flow of Pilates, the rhythm and energy of dance, and the grounding presence of yoga and breathwork, this session will leave you feeling strong, balanced, and revitalized. Open to all levels, this fun and fast-paced class welcomes everyone looking to build strength, flexibility, and mindfulness in a supportive community space. It is exercise in disguise! No dance experience is required—just bring your energy, a water bottle, and a smile. This class is free and open to the public, but donations for the instructor are always welcome.
